#learnenglish #englishvocabulary #falsefriends #englishmistakes #esl

slides.title: Same word… *different* meaning 😬
slides.sub: 5 false friends B1 learners mix up

slides.label: Actually
slides.wrong: Actually, I live in London. (= now)

slides.label: Eventually
slides.wrong: Eventually I'll come, if I have time.
slides.right: *Maybe* I'll come, if I have time.
slides.tip: *eventually* = in the end, after a long time

slides.label: Library
slides.wrong: I bought this book at the library.
slides.right: I bought this book at the *bookshop*.
slides.tip: *library* = you borrow books · *bookshop* = you buy them

slides.title: Use them right in real conversations with *Lupa* 🎙️
